Use block letters when copying entries onto the form. For each `NEEDS-YOU` item, check the relevant document or fill it in privately on your device.

### 1. Personal details

**B01 Family Name**

ESCALANTE

**B02 Given Names**

MARICEL

BUENAFLOR

Copy your given names into B02 by hand, in the order shown in the passport’s given-name field. Include the middle name if it appears in that field.

- **B03 Name in Chinese characters** — NEEDS-YOU. Confirm whether you have a name in Chinese characters to enter.
- **B04 Sex** — Check **Female**.
- **B05 Date of Birth** — Use the value below. If its printed format differs, write it by hand as `yyyy/mm/dd`, using four digits for the year and two each for the month and day.

09 AUG 1991

- **B06 Nationality** — FILIPINO.
- **B07 Country of Birth** — NEEDS-YOU if the birthplace below does not identify the country. If it does, write only the country by hand.

CEBU CITY

- **B08 National Identity No.** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your national identity number privately if you have one.
- **B09 Other names used to enter or depart Korea** — NEEDS-YOU. Check Yes or No. If Yes, enter the family and given names you used.
- **B10 Multiple citizenships** — NEEDS-YOU. Check Yes or No. If Yes, list your other citizenships.

- **B17 Other valid passport** — NEEDS-YOU. Check Yes or No. If Yes, provide its type, number, issuing country and expiry date.

### 3. Contact information

- **B18 Home Country Address** — NEEDS-YOU if the saved address below is not your home-country address. Enter the full home-country address.
- **B19 Current Residential Address** — Enter your full Singapore address if it differs from B18. NEEDS-YOU if the saved address below is not your current Singapore address.

Use the saved address for whichever field it matches.

Blk 418 Bedok North Avenue 2, #07-215, Singapore 460418

- **B20 Cell Phone No.** — NEEDS-YOU if the saved number below is not your mobile number.
- **B21 Telephone No.** — NEEDS-YOU if you have a separate telephone number and it is missing here.

Copy the saved number into the field that matches its type.

+65 8555 0143

- **B22 Email** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your email address.
- **B23 Emergency Contact Name** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your mother’s full name in English.
- **B24 Emergency Contact Country of Residence** — PHILIPPINES.
- **B25 Emergency Contact Telephone No.** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your mother’s phone number.
- **B26 Relationship** — MOTHER.

### 4. Marital status and family

- **B27 Marital Status** — Check **Single**.
- **B28–B33 Spouse Details** — Leave blank. These fields apply only if you select Married.
- **B34 Children** — Check **No**. Leave the child-count box blank.

### 5. Education

- **B35 Highest Education** — Check **Bachelor’s Degree**. Your degree is in nursing.
- **B36 School Name** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the name of the school that awarded your nursing degree.
- **B37 School Location** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the school’s city, province and country.

### 6. Employment

B38 asks about your current circumstances. The Seoul nursing offer alone does not establish your current employment status.

- **B38 Current Personal Circumstances** — NEEDS-YOU. Check the option that applies to you now. If you select Other, provide details.
- **B39 Company, Institution or School Name** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the name that corresponds to your current status, if applicable.
- **B40 Position or Course** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter your current position or course, if applicable.
- **B41 Company, Institution or School Address** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter its full address, if applicable.
- **B42 Telephone No.** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter its telephone number, if applicable.
